vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: diff
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle is classified as suspicious due to a significant discrepancy between its documentation and its actual implementation. While SKILL.md describes a 'Diff toolkit' capable of comparing files, merging changes, and generating patches, the code in scripts/script.sh contains no such functionality; it instead functions as a simple logger that appends input strings to files in ~/.local/share/diff/. This deceptive misalignment between the stated purpose and the actual logic is a red flag, although no explicitly malicious behaviors such as data exfiltration or remote code execution were identified.

llm.summary: The skill claims to be a file/directory diff and merge tool but the shipped script only implements a local logging/notes-style interface that writes to ~/.local/share/diff — the capability description and implementation are inconsistent.

dimensions.detail: The name/description advertise file/directory comparison, merging and patch generation, but the included script mostly records timestamped text entries to per-command log files and supports exports/stats/search. There is no implemented file-diffing, merging, or patch-generation logic visible in the provided script — this is an overclaim in the description.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the script operate only on a local data directory (~/.local/share/diff by default) and stdout. The runtime instructions and code read/write files only under that directory and do not attempt to access other system paths or external network endpoints in the visible code.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only skill plus a bundled script). That is low-risk since nothing is downloaded or installed automatically by the registry; behavior is limited to executing the included script.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not require credentials or declared env vars. SKILL.md mentions an optional DIFF_DIR to change the data directory, but requires.env is empty (minor documentation mismatch). The script uses HOME to compute the data directory — this is expected and proportional to the tool's stated local-storage behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent/always-on privileges and will only create and write files in its own data directory. It does not modify other skills or system-wide settings in the visible code.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears safe in that it only reads/writes files under ~/.local/share/diff and has no network calls or credential access in the visible code. However, the README/description overstates functionality (promises file/directory diffs, merges, patches) while the bundled script behaves like a local activity/entry logger and exporter. Before installing or running it: 1) review the full script (ensure no hidden parts beyond the truncated portion) and confirm it meets your needs, 2) if you expect true file-diff/merge behavior, test on non-sensitive files first (or avoid), and 3) consider running it in a restricted environment or container if you are unsure about executing code from an unknown source.
